## enable_tools

- Title: Enable tool profiles
- Profile: always on
- Annotations: `openWorldHint: false`, `readOnlyHint: true`

Turn on more Sui tool profiles for this session. When a tool you need is not in your list, call this first: it is disabled, not missing. Do not rebuild a tool by hand. Pass `profile` or `profiles`: one name, several, or 'all'. Enabled tools are callable at once.

On: core, forensics, developer, market. Every profile is on.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | `core` \| `forensics` \| `developer` \| `market` \| `all` \| array of (`core` \| `forensics` \| `developer` \| `market` \| `all`) | no | Profile to enable, or 'all'. Accepts several: ['forensics','developer']. |
| `profiles` | `core` \| `forensics` \| `developer` \| `market` \| `all` \| array of (`core` \| `forensics` \| `developer` \| `market` \| `all`) | no | Alias for `profile`. Same values; use whichever reads better. |
